jane_auditor: Hi team — auditor wants a clear mapping for ISO A.9 / SOC2 CC6.1 around a recent service-account role change. They asked for: PR link, approver trail, Jira ticket, cloud audit entry, KMS key usage tied to the same principal, and any vuln-triage notes if the change was related to a remediation. Can we produce a single evidence bundle?

nina_seceng: Yep. We should include: GitHub PR(s) with reviewers, Jira ENG-5012, cloud audit export (CloudTrail/GCP AuditLogs depending on env), KMS logs (decrypt/encrypt), and a short triage.md if vuln was involved.

chuck_cloud: For GCP the query is: `resource.type=\"service_account\" AND protoPayload.methodName:\"SetIamPolicy\"` and filter by principalEmail. I can export the JSON rows for the time window 2026-04-02T08:00Z..2026-04-02T12:00Z.

ryan_oncall: PR was github.com/redwood/repo/PR/3121 — changed service-account from roles/pubsub.publisher -> roles/pubsub.publisher + roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor. Approved by `@nina_seceng` and `@ryan_oncall`. Comment: "approved minimal secret access for rotation job".

jane_auditor: Need to confirm the exact principal used by the job and prove KMS involvement (did the job actually decrypt?).

chuck_cloud: KMS logs show CryptoKeyAccess for key `projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/ops/cryptoKeys/rotation-key`. Snippets (sanitized):
```
2026-04-02T08:33:12Z principalEmail=ci-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=decrypt key=rotation-key version=5
2026-04-02T08:33:13Z principalEmail=ci-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=decrypt key=rotation-key version=5
```

amy_devrel: I can produce a timeline diagram for the auditor: PR created -> PR approved -> Jira linked -> deploy job run -> KMS decrypt events. Will add a human-readable timeline.png to the bundle.

nina_seceng: Triage note: this change was driven by vulnerability RD-2026-11 (principals used by rotation job lacked least-privilege). We applied a scoped permission change instead of granting broad project-level access. I'll include triage.md with risk, mitigation, reviewer notes, and verification steps.

ryan_oncall: No rollbacks. Post-deploy smoke check run: `make smoke` passed. Logs show no errors.

jane_auditor: Also need proof that exported logs are immutable and retained per policy. What's retention and storage?

chuck_cloud: Exports go to `s3://redwood-compliance/iso-evidence/YYYY/MM/DD/` (aws) with Object Lock enabled (governance) for 365 days. On GCP we mirror to a locked bucket with retention policy 365d. ACLs are restricted to `compliance-role` and `ops-bot`. I'll attach `aws s3api get-object-retention` output sample.

opsbot: EvidenceBuilder: packaging started by nina_seceng at 2026-04-03T09:15:00Z. job_id=evid-20260403-0915.

chuck_cloud: IAM audit entry (redacted) snippet:
```
{
  "timestamp": "2026-04-02T08:32:58Z",
  "actor": "nina_seceng@redwood-inference.com",
  "target": "serviceAccounts/ci-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
  "change": {
    "bindings_before": ["roles/pubsub.publisher"],
    "bindings_after": ["roles/pubsub.publisher","roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"]
  }
}
```

nina_seceng: For chain-of-custody: packaged_by=nina_seceng, packaged_at=2026-04-03T09:15:00Z, package_sha256 computed by `sha256sum` and stored in `manifest.txt`. I'll include screenshots of PR approvals and the Jira ticket export (PDF).

amy_devrel: Adding timeline.png and short explainer `readme.txt` that maps each artifact to control language (ISO A.9.2.3 / SOC2 CC6.1). Example mapping lines in readme: `artifact=iam-audit.json -> control=ISO A.9.2.3 evidence=access modification logged`

jane_auditor: Please ensure redaction doesn't remove the principal identity — auditor needs matchable but not public emails. Use deterministic hash mapping (e.g., principalHash: sha256(email)). Include a lookup file that is only provided to auditors if needed.

chuck_cloud: We'll include `principal_hashes.csv` with lines like `svc:sha256(ci-runner@redwood...)=b1946ac...` and cert that the full mapping is held in compliance vault.

opsbot: EvidenceBuilder: package uploaded s3://redwood-compliance/iso-evidence/ENG-5012/evid-20260403-0915.zip size=3.1MB checksum=9c7d4f... retention=365d.

jane_auditor: Received bundle URL. I'll validate the manifest and then request any additional clarifications. One quick ask: can you attach the vulnerability ticket link and brief mitigation verification?

nina_seceng: Ticket added: RD-2026-11 (linked in manifest). Mitigation verification: `kubectl get cronjob rotation-job -o jsonpath='{.spec.jobTemplate.spec.template.spec.serviceAccountName}'` returned `ci-runner`, and post-change `gcloud projects get-iam-policy` shows the scoped binding only. I'll paste the verification commands in triage.md.

ryan_oncall: Marking ENG-5012 resolved in Jira. Closing the loop.

jane_auditor: Thanks all — this looks good. I'll file follow-up questions if the auditor needs the unhashed principal mapping. :thumbsup:
